summary: Rebuilds the VCR replay file browser list. Clears the selection flag at this+0x131, resets the UI list via StateCleanupNotification, primes the search-result linked list, scans the replay directory (lpPathName or default byte_5EA438) with the aVcr_0 pattern through the search API (sub_565F80/sub_566380), iterates the result list creating a UI menu item per stripped file name, then selects the initial/saved file name v6 and resets the list. Matches existing-analysis name VcrFileBrowserBuilder.
